notes.title: Early access update 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
The first update for the game is just released!

WHAT'S NEW:

    More physics!
    Sandbox game mode
    A new playable map
    Improved graphics
    Breakable and sinking vehicles
    A new type of unit: special unit, you can place them on the water after you placed your vehicles
   Vehicles are destroyable by sharks
Player progress and currency system with unit shop

NEW UNITS:

    Horsefish rider
    Piranha rider
Catapult
Fire archer
Jumper shark (jumps in the air and catches enemy units) 
Big shark (eats the enemy's vehicles) 
Tub



Bugs Fixed

    Flying rafts
    Cosmetic bugs (sailor flag on the pirate ships, weapon holding etc...)
    Custom match bugs
    Navigation issues
    Camera collides with units

Improvements

    Refined unit AI
    Refined unit navigation
    Refined camera system
    The game runs smoother on older machines
    The camera now collides with the map
    Improved UI and menu system
    No more misspelled menus (hopefully)



MORE TO COME
Watch our updated trailer with the new features:
https://youtu.be/WeOw5UlhJnY
